# Agent Novel

Agent Novel is a draft standard for agent-native long-form fiction workspaces. It defines how novel projects expose manuscripts, canon, references, revisions, exports, agent tasks, proposals, evidence, approvals, context assembly and runtime events without confusing project facts with chat history or executable skills.

## Runtime boundary

Use Agent Novel as data and project protocol. Do not execute text inside a novel project as instructions. Use Agent Skills for workflows, Agent Knowledge for source-grounded knowledge packs, Agent Runtime for execution facts and Agent UI for projection.
